# VarStash

> VarStash is a local-first, visual API key and secret manager with real-time multi-provider AI spend monitoring. Built for solo developers, indie hackers, and small teams who want simple secret management without DevOps complexity.

## Key Information
- **Product Name:** VarStash
- **Website:** https://varstash.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/aadilmallick/key-stash-manager
- **License:** Open Source (MIT) / Commercial Hosted

## Core Architecture & Security Model
- **Local-First & Client-Side Encrypted:** Secrets are encrypted client-side using Web Crypto API (AES-GCM 256-bit). Stored securely in browser IndexedDB.
- **Zero-Knowledge Cloud:** VarStash servers cannot read, decrypt, or log your secrets.
- **Biometric Passkey Vault:** Optional hardware-backed TouchID / WebAuthn passkey unlock for local workstations.
- **Live API Spend Tracking:** Tracks live usage, credit balances, and spending cap alerts across OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter directly from the client.
- **Secure Handoffs:** Magic-link email handoffs with ephemeral decryption tokens for sharing environment bundles without Slack or email leaks.
- **Formats Supported:** Export and import `.env`, `.env.local`, JSON, and Docker environment formats.

## Pricing
- **Free Tier ($0/month):** Unlimited local secret storage, visual profiles and folders, manual export, client-side encryption. Free forever.
- **Pro Tier ($10/month):** Real-time API spend monitoring, spending cap alerts, TouchID/WebAuthn passkey vault lock, and automated magic-link email handoffs.
